title: How Specific Labs hired its founding data team in under 1.5 months
summary: AI labs need training data built from real engineering work, and Specific Labs makes it. This summer, as the labs came calling, the company had to hire fast. Here’s how Contrario helped them get there.
body_markdown: AI coding agents ace public benchmarks. Put them on a real company's codebase and they struggle. Specific Labs is built on that gap: it turns real engineering work into the training data AI labs need to close it. This summer, as the labs came calling, the company needed two hard-to-find hires fast: an RL engineer who had already built coding RL environments and shipped agents to production, and a founding Strategic Projects Lead to run those lab contracts.
